title: An Exotic Congruence for Irregular Weight Picard Modular Forms
summary: We construct a new type of congruence from irregular weight mod $p$ Picard modular forms (for $p$ inert) to ones of regular weight, analogous to the one obtained by Kansal--Levin--Savitt in the Hilbert setting. The congruence is obtained by using a geometric Jacquet--Langlands phenomenon, as first established by Vollaard, to transfer irregular weight mod $p$ Picard modular forms from the Picard modular surface to a Shimura set.
